4247-7084-8337.description:

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.

443-3025-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-3025-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

670-804-1619-2719.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-2719.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-2719.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.

Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.

Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.

When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.

2034-2232-4010-4231.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-2232-4010-4231.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Farmer Cotton trigger, creating two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens.
When the Halflings enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Farmer Cotton to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Halfling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Halfling tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite colorless mana, which can be used to cast Farmer Cotton for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to create infinite Treasure tokens.
